identity.patternName: Direction and Autonomy Mismatch — Leadership direction versus team autonomy

sourceMaterial.sourceEvidence: Leader Ownership: Directing Work. Leader Trust: Control-Based Leadership. Squad Ownership: Team Drives Delivery.
sourceMaterial.relationshipLogic: Leader behaviours may indicate a preference for explicit direction or control, while Squad behaviours may indicate an ability or desire to drive delivery. This may create friction around who determines how work is organised and decisions are made.

sourceEvaluation.notes: Candidate evidence is not yet an executable trigger. Confirm required, alternative, supporting, and contradictory behaviour combinations before defining conditions.
